name: cavemio-button-group
title: Button group
description: Connected actions on one surface: a selection fill that is thrown to the segment you pick, dividers that fade beside it, labels that fold into icons when narrow.

cavemio.accessibility:
- No external animation libraries: uses CSS transitions and native layout geometry.
- Full keyboard accessibility: navigate with Arrow keys, Home, and End.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · Array of action items in the group.

props.name: variant
props.description: "outline" · Outline with thin line border or solid dark fill.

props.name: collapseLabels
props.description: true · Automatically collapse labels to icons when space overflows.

useCases.title: Editor toolbars
useCases.description: Text alignment, formatting, and view toggle controls.

useCases.title: Segmented view switches
useCases.description: Switching between Grid, List, and Table layouts.

useCases.title: Responsive header controls
useCases.description: Actions that collapse gracefully on mobile devices.

features.title: Gliding highlight
features.description: A soft pill highlight glides seamlessly between segments on hover or arrow-key focus.

features.title: Quiet dividers
features.description: Internal thin line dividers fade out beside the active segment so the highlight reads as a clean shape.

features.title: Auto-collapsing labels
features.description: When container space is constrained, text labels collapse into icons automatically while preserving full accessibility and titles.

features.title: Horizontal & vertical
features.description: Supports both horizontal toolbars and vertical sidebar action bars.

states.title: idle
states.description: A thin line capsule (28 or 36px) with dividers between segments.

states.title: pressed
states.description: The segment gives 3% under the finger and settles back (200ms).

states.title: selected
states.description: The fill is thrown from the old segment to the new one with a slight overshoot while its width eases (440ms); dividers beside it fade.

states.title: compact
states.description: When the row stops fitting, labels fold into their icons (column 1fr → 0fr, 400ms) and open again when there is room.
